text: On behalf of local residents, I am requesting that the existing No Parking Anytime regulation on the west side of Gladys Allison Place be amended to No Parking 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday. The change would be consistent with the regulations within the surrounding community and provide parking for those wanting to access the parks in the vicinity during evenings and weekends. This request also corrects a discrepancy between the Municipal Code Chapter 950 (Traffic and Parking) by-law and what is currently signed in the field.

North York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the west side of Gladys Allison Place between Hollywood Avenue and a point 15 metres north of Hillcrest Avenue. 2. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect from 11:00 p.m. of one day to 9:30 a.m. of the next following day, on the west side of Gladys Allison Place between a point 15 metres north of Hillcrest Avenue and a point 15 metres south of Princess Avenue. 3. Prohibited parking from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday on the west side of Gladys Allison Place between Hollywood Avenue and a point 20 metres south of Princess Avenue. 4. Prohibited parking at all times on the west side of Gladys Allison Place between Princess Avenue and a point 20 metres south.
